messages.author: dea7fe9fc1920d2f
messages.subject: ShinySky textInput.typeahead problem
parts:
Hi everybody,

the textInput.typeahead from ShinySky is a very handy addition to the user interface elements in shiny. One problem I noticed is that it never resets once you have done a selection. This is already visible in
run.shinysky.example(). Type as suggested "name" into the field, select one of the entries, see the selected value in the corresponding output. Then delete the text in the input until the placeholder is visible again, but the previously selected value is still visible in the output.

Any ideas to circumvent or fix this?

Thanks a lot

Thomas
